mapper.sql: SELECT l.id AS id, l.source_log_id AS sourceLogId, l.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, l.event_id AS eventId, l.event_time AS eventTime, l.username AS username, l.login_result AS loginResult, l.login_type AS loginType, l.source_ip AS sourceIp, l.process_name AS processName, l.is_elevated AS isElevated FROM login_security_logs l LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = l.host_id AND h.tenant_id = l.tenant_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY l.${q.sortColumn} ${q.sortDirection}, l.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
ORDER BY l.${q.sortColumn} ${q.sortDirection}, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.id AS id, l.source_log_id AS sourceLogId, l.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, l.event_id AS eventId, l.event_time AS eventTime, l.username AS username, l.login_result AS loginResult, l.login_type AS loginType, l.source_ip AS sourceIp, l.process_name AS processName, l.is_elevated AS isElevated, l.create_time AS createTime, w.message AS logMessage, w.raw_json AS rawXml FROM login_security_logs l LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = l.host_id AND h.tenant_id = l.tenant_id LEFT JOIN windows_event_logs w ON w.id = l.source_log_id AND w.tenant_id = l.tenant_id WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM login_security_logs WHERE is_elevated = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(event_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT h.id AS id, h.hostname AS hostname, h.ipv4 AS ipv4 FROM hosts h WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY h.id ASC
